scripts.build: rm -f ./build/** && npm run webpack && npx web-ext build --source-dir ./extension/ --artifacts-dir ./build && npm run source
scripts.source: export DEST='./build/source' ; rm -rf ${DEST} && mkdir ${DEST} && cp README.md ${DEST} && cp package-lock.json ${DEST} && cp package.json ${DEST} && cp webpack.config.js ${DEST} && cp -r ./src ${DEST} && tar -czf ./build/source.tar.gz ${DEST} && rm -rf ${DEST}
scripts.style: npm run format ; npm run lint ; npm run yaml ; npm run rubocop ; npm run semgrep
scripts.update:all: npm run update:js ; npm run update:python ; npm run update:ruby
scripts.update:python: sed -i '' -E 's/[=><~!]=.*//' requirements.txt && source ./pydeps/bin/activate && python3 -m pip install --upgrade --requirement requirements.txt && pip3 freeze > requirements.txt
